candidate.purpose: Test the integrated personal SQLite bootstrap, durable writes and backups on an existing Android installation.
candidate.signing: Reuse the existing CINEVAULT_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_B64 secret; verify the final APK with apksigner and compare its certificate to that key before upload.
candidate.distribution: GitHub Actions test artifact only; no store submission, public release or latest.json update.

buildControls: Use the lockfile, Node 24.21.0, JDK 21 and the same pinned native dependencies.
Derive native versionName and versionCode from LOCAL_RELEASE and reject inconsistent package metadata.
Keep the existing package identity and temporary test signing key; do not substitute a store signing key.
Reject audit HTML or the synthetic probe script in the device APK.
Verify the packaged native SQLite plugin, ARM64 library and real persistence bootstrap.
Deliver only the APK, SHA-256, public verification metadata and a short test guide. Never upload keystore material.
The audit branch starts this build only for a commit marked [device-test], or a manual workflow invocation.
realDeviceChecklist: Before installation, export a fresh backup from the currently installed app and keep earlier backups.
Record representative personal data and preferences for comparison without uploading private values.
Install as an update; if Android refuses the update, stop without uninstalling or clearing data.
Confirm version 1.3.3/build16 and compare personal data after the first native migration.
Save a favorite, watched entry and note; close and reopen the app, then check those changes.
Check queue, watch journal and preferences, including offline access.
Export the new complete raw backup and keep it outside the app before guided restoration/recovery tests.
remainingGates: Apply this preparation on the audit worktree and pass the actual signed-APK GitHub job.
Compare the resulting commit, APK hash, native package/version and signer before installation.
Complete real Android data-preservation, save/reopen and backup/recovery checks.
Prepare a separate signed iOS build and validate it on an iPhone before store submission.
Keep the broader Sintonema brand, audiovisual catalogue and production-store requirements in their existing roadmap.
